entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Ms. Sonali Gupta, counsel for the petitioners Suresh and Rakesh.
 Shri Bhaskar Agrawal, counsel for the respondent/State.
Heard on IA No.3260/2022, first application under Section 397 (1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the petitioners.

The present petitioners have been convicted and sentenced by Judicial Magistrate First Class,
Kukshi, District - Dhar in Criminal Case No.594 of 2011 on 25.03.2017, which has been affirmed by the I Additional Sessions Judge Kukshi, District - Dhar in Cr.A. No.32/2017 vide order dated 25.02.2022 as under:-
 Conviction Sentence  Section Act RI compensation Imprisonment in  amount lieu of fine  16(1) A Prevention 6-6 Rs.1,000/- 1-1 month SI  (I)(II) of Food months each  Adulteration  Act

entities.text:
Judicial Magistrate First Class,
Kukshi, District - Dhar
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: I Additional Sessions Judge Kukshi, District - Dhar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for the petitioners has submitted that there are fair chances of success in the revision, there is no possibility of early disposal of this revision in near future; and if the sentence is not suspended,
then the present revision filed by the petitioners may turn infructuous.
Under these circumstances and looking to the short sentence imposed on the petitioners, counsel for the petitioners prays for suspension of jail sentence of the petitioners and grant of bail to them.
HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH : BENCH AT INDORE Suresh and another Vs. State of M.P.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence deserves to be allowed.

Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, IA No.3260/2022 is allowed and it is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount and on furnishing a personal bond by the petitioners in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) each with separate solvent Suresh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 March, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67501327/

sentences.text: in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court

, for their regular appearance before concerned trial Court, the execution of the custodial part of the sentence imposed against the petitioners shall remain suspended, till the final disposal of this revision.

The petitioners, after being enlarged on bail, shall mark their presence before the concerned trial Court on 11.05.2022 and on all such subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the concerned Court in this regard.
List the matter on the question of admission.
Counsel for the petitioners is also directed to amend the prayer in the revision.
